Client money: final rules confirmed on annual accountant's reports

Published 12 November 2026

Our Board approved the final rules on accountant's reports on 11 November 2026. We closed the consultation early because we had received enough responses to decide.

From 1 March 2027, every firm that holds client money must send us an accountant's report within six months of the end of its accounting period.

We have made one change from our proposal. Firms that held an average of less than 10,000 pounds of client money over the year are exempt.

A fixed penalty of 750 pounds applies to any report that is late or missing.

The rules apply to all firms we regulate that hold client money, apart from the exempt firms.

Northbridge Legal Standards Authority. Test page, not a real regulator.
